Package com.hkust.marketplace.data

Interface Storage

All Known Implementing Classes:
EncryptedJsonStorage
public interface Storage
Where a DataStore's data is kept between runs. DataStore depends only on this interface, not on files or formats, so how data is stored can change without touching the rest of the system (Lecture 15: encapsulate the implementation environment behind a bridge). The app uses EncryptedJsonStorage; tests use a store without storage.
